source.stem: Which of the following statements about the scope and definition of the biosphere is correct: () A. The general name of all living things on the earth; B. All of the atmosphere, hydrosphere and lithosphere; C. The place where all living things on the earth can live; D. All living things on the earth and the environment in which they live

intelligence.enrichment: All living beings are made up of cells. A cell is the basic unit of life because one cell can be a whole unicellular organism, and many cells can build a multicellular organism. Cells as basic building blocks -> one or many cells form living organisms -> organism functions become possible. The learner correctly applies this rule: All living beings are made up of cells. A cell is the basic unit of life because one cell can be a whole unicellular organism, and many cells can build a multicellular organism. Only large plants and animals are made of cells; tiny bacteria are just specks, not cell-based organisms.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Microorganisms: friend and foe.
